description:
আন্দামান দ্বীপপুঞ্জ ভ্রমণ

This is my first travel vlog ever on youtube. In this vlog i’m traveling from Dhaka, Bangladesh to Andaman & Nicobar Island via Kolkata, India. I started my journey 15th Aug 2019 at 10pm. 16th Aug i reached Kolkata at evening. Night stayed in Kolkata airport and then next morning 17th Aug my flight was 5.30am. I reached Port Blair at 8am. Took rest and after lunch i explored very popular Spot CELLULAR JAIL. Then back to hotel room and lights off :D
